subject: planner: Column prune improvement for MPP Join and TableScan+Filter operators (#52143)
summary: Reviewed planner-only changes in `pkg/planner/core/rule_column_pruning.go` and `pkg/planner/core/task.go`: DataSource column pruning can insert an explicit Projection for MPP to drop filter-only columns, and MPP HashJoin attach now adds a Projection to preserve pruned output while keeping TiFlash join schema semantic. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in this commit relative to its first parent.
